label: Battery
depicts: Battery outline with an empty body and a terminal nub on the right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a battery shape without any visible charge bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for the filled levels when the body should remain empty inside.

label: Battery
depicts: Battery outline with one vertical charge bar near the left side
use_when: Use when the interface needs a low battery symbol with one visible charge segment.
avoid_when: Do not use for higher charge levels when only one vertical bar should be shown.

label: Battery
depicts: Battery outline with two vertical charge bars inside the body
use_when: Use when the interface needs a battery level between low and high with two bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for one three or four bar levels when the count must stay at two.

label: Battery
depicts: Battery outline with three vertical charge bars inside the body
use_when: Use when the interface needs a battery symbol that looks mostly charged but not full.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two or four bar levels when the count of interior bars matters.

label: Battery
depicts: Battery outline with four vertical charge bars filling most of the body
use_when: Use when the interface wants the fullest battery state in this five icon battery group.
avoid_when: Do not use for lower battery levels when all four charge bars should stay visible.
